fact: Law No. 103-12 on credit institutions, consolidated at 31 March 2022, is in force, defines electronic money as a means of payment and lets licensed non-bank payment institutions offer payment services (Arts. 6, 15-16, 18).
title: Loi n° 103-12 relative aux établissements de crédit et organismes assimilés, telle que modifiée et complétée (version consolidée au 31 mars 2022)
